name: popsicle
headline: Twitter Automation Bot: Follow & Engage
short_description: "Facebook-auto-followers is an app designed to simplify the process of growing your Facebook following. With advanced automation tools and targeted audience filtering, effortlessly gain new followers and expand your reach on one of the world's largest social media platforms. #Twitter #SocialMedia #Automation"
author: maxgraber

sections.overview:
This is a Python-based Twitter bot that automates interactions with the Twitter API, including following users, favoriting tweets, and retweeting content based on specific phrases or hashtags. The bot maintains local cache files to manage followers and following lists while respecting Twitter API rate limits. Users configure OAuth credentials and can trigger multiple automated actions such as auto-following users who tweet keywords, following new followers, or unfollowing non-reciprocal accounts. The bot is designed for developers who need programmatic control over Twitter engagement workflows.
Auto-follow users tweeting specific keywords or hashtags
Follow all new followers automatically
Auto-favorite tweets matching search phrases
Auto-retweet tweets with specific content
sections.setup:

sections.usage:
```
Act as a Facebook Page Auto-Follower tool. I want to grow my Facebook page's followers. My page is about [TOPIC], targeting [AUDIENCE]. Suggest a 30-day strategy to gain [TARGET_FOLLOWERS] followers. Include daily tasks, engagement tactics, and content ideas.
```
